description: This is a unit test class for EncounterValidator within the org.openmrs.validator package, testing various validation scenarios for Encounter objects.

classes.name: EncounterValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the EncounterValidator's validation logic within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EncounterValidator, Encounter, and Errors objects before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that validation throws an exception when the input object is null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfOtherClassThanEncounter
methods.description: Tests that validation throws an exception when the input object is not an Encounter instance.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThePatientsForTheVisitAndTheEncounterDontMatch
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if Encounter's patient does not match Visit's patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheVisitHasNoPatient
methods.description: Checks validation failure when the Visit linked to Encounter lacks a patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies validation fails if the Encounter's patient is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsBeforeVisitStartDateTime
methods.description: Tests validation failure if Encounter date is before the start date of the associated Visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsAfterVisitStopDateTime
methods.description: Tests validation failure if Encounter date is after the Visit's stop date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsAfterCurrentDateTime
methods.description: Checks that Encounter date cannot be set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if Encounter date is not provided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterTypeIsNotSet
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if Encounter type is missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all fields are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Validates that overly long text in fields like voidReason causes validation to fail.
